verdict.rationale: Smithery once documented a Vercel AI SDK integration that aggregated tools across servers, with Smithery handling OAuth and connections. Its own shutdown notice says that on October 31, 2026 the Smithery API, Connect, Toolbox, CLI and SDKs stopped working and the docs tree was removed, so that integration no longer functions. No adapters for LangChain, CrewAI, or the OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs are evidenced at all.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the platform's tools into major agent frameworks and SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs) with documented adapters
